title: "Tools I like"

---

These are tools I actually use and recommend to friends and family.
Most are free.
I'm not paid to mention any of them.
If you'd like help setting one up, just ask.

## Staying safe online

::: {.ftw-grid}

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-key" aria-hidden="true"></i> Bitwarden
A password manager that remembers strong, unique passwords for every site, on your computer and phone.
It also stores passkeys, the newer way to log in without a password that scammers can't phish.
Free for most people.

[bitwarden.com](https://bitwarden.com/)
:::

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-shield-lock" aria-hidden="true"></i> Ente Auth
An app for the six-digit login codes (two-step login).
Your codes are backed up, so a lost phone doesn't lock you out.

[ente.io/auth](https://ente.io/auth/)
:::

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-slash-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i> uBlock Origin
Blocks ads, pop-ups, and many scam sites in your web browser.
Works best in Firefox.
On Chrome, use uBlock Origin Lite.

[ublockorigin.com](https://ublockorigin.com/)
:::

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-windows" aria-hidden="true"></i> Microsoft Defender
The antivirus already built into Windows.
For most home users, it's all you need, so you can skip the paid antivirus subscriptions.
Look for "Windows Security" in the Start menu.
:::

:::

## Search and AI

::: {.ftw-grid}

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-search-heart" aria-hidden="true"></i> Kagi
A search engine with no ads and no tracking, so the results are about what you searched for, not who paid to be on top.
It's paid, but worth it.
It includes Kagi Assistant, an AI chat assistant.

[kagi.com](https://kagi.com/)
:::

:::

## Windows helpers

::: {.ftw-grid}

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-pie-chart" aria-hidden="true"></i> WinDirStat
Shows what's filling up your hard drive, as a colorful map, so you know what to clean up.

[windirstat.net](https://windirstat.net/)
:::

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i> Everything
Finds any file on your computer instantly as you type.
Much faster than the built-in Windows search.

[voidtools.com](https://www.voidtools.com/)
:::

:::

## Backups

::: {.ftw-grid}

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-cloud-arrow-up" aria-hidden="true"></i> Backrest
Automatic, scheduled backups of your files to an external drive or cloud storage.
A simple web page shows that your backups ran and lets you browse and restore old files.
Works on Windows, Mac, and Linux.
A little more for the tinkerers, and I'm happy to set it up for you.

[Backrest](https://garethgeorge.github.io/backrest/)
:::

:::

## Remote help

::: {.ftw-grid}

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-display" aria-hidden="true"></i> RustDesk
Lets someone see and control your computer from afar, so I can help without a visit.
Free, and works on Windows, Mac, Linux, and phones.

**Only let someone connect if you know and trust them.**
Scammers use apps like this too.
If a stranger calls and asks you to install one, hang up.

[rustdesk.com](https://rustdesk.com/)
:::

:::

## Smart homes

::: {.ftw-grid}

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-house-gear" aria-hidden="true"></i> Home Assistant
Brings smart lights, thermostats, locks, and sensors from different brands together in one app, with automations like "turn on the porch light at sunset."
It runs in your home, so it keeps working when the internet or a company's cloud goes down.
A project for the tinkerers, and I'm happy to help set it up.

[home-assistant.io](https://www.home-assistant.io/)
:::

:::

## Phones, maps, and the outdoors

::: {.ftw-grid}

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-signpost-split" aria-hidden="true"></i> COTREX
Colorado's official, free trail map app, with offline maps and fire alerts.
Great for our local trails.

[trails.colorado.gov](https://trails.colorado.gov/)
:::

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-map" aria-hidden="true"></i> CoMaps
Free offline maps and directions for anywhere in the world, with no ads or tracking.

[comaps.app](https://www.comaps.app/)
:::

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-android2" aria-hidden="true"></i> F-Droid
An app store for Android with free, open-source apps and no ads or tracking.
A little more for the tinkerers.

[f-droid.org](https://f-droid.org/)
:::

:::

## Reading and watching

::: {.ftw-grid}

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-film" aria-hidden="true"></i> Kanopy
Free movies and shows with your library card, on your TV, phone, or computer.
Mesa County Libraries offers it, so you can sign up with your Mesa County library card.

[kanopy.com](https://www.kanopy.com/)
:::

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-rss" aria-hidden="true"></i> RSS readers
Follow your favorite news sites and blogs in one place, without algorithms or social media.
Feedly and Inoreader are easy places to start.
I use FreshRSS with the FeedMe app.

[What is RSS?](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RSS)
:::

:::
